name: Fairview Plaza
summary: Fairview Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center on Highway 6 in Missouri City, Texas, serving the southwest Houston area with convenient daily retail and services. Operating from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM with a 4.4-star rating, it provides accessible shopping for local residents and commuters.
demographics: Fairview Plaza serves the Missouri City community, a diverse suburban area southwest of Houston with a strong middle-class demographic. The trade area attracts families with median to above-median household incomes, including a significant population of young professionals and established households. Primary shoppers include convenience-oriented consumers seeking quick-service dining and essential services during weekday evenings and weekends, with a preference for accessible, neighborhood-focused retail options.
description: Fairview Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center conveniently located at 6850 Highway 6 in Missouri City, Texas, serving the southwest Houston metropolitan area. This accessible retail destination caters to the daily needs of local residents and commuters along the busy Highway 6 corridor. The center maintains convenient operating hours from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, making it an ideal stop for both morning errands and evening shopping. With a solid 4.4-star rating from community reviews, Fairview Plaza has established itself as a reliable neighborhood retail hub. The center's strategic location in Missouri City positions it within a thriving suburban community that continues to experience growth and development in the greater Houston area.
